messages:
maria (AE): Dropped the Acme pen-test + vuln-scan bundle into the secure bucket: s3://redwood-sec/acme/1951234999_bundle.zip :paperclip:
security-bot: Upload completed, virus scan OK. SHA256: a1f4d3...
eli (Security Eng): Quick check 1 - are hostnames/IPs redacted? We should avoid exposing internal hostnames.
maria (AE): Redacted and scrubbed for PII. Contact for Acme is lisa@acme.com for procurement.
devon (Infra): I see ACL and IAM issues flagged. I'll take S3/IAM ownership and open remediation PRs.
sarah (Solutions Eng): Can someone add reproduction steps for the auth elevation (finding #3)? Need to validate in a controlled PoC prior to fixes.
eli (Security Eng): Triage summary (preliminary): 3 HIGH, 9 MEDIUM, 6 LOW. Highs: public S3 ACL, wildcard IAM role, auth elevation path. Created triage sheet: https://docs.redwood.internal/triage/ACME-1951234999 (owners + ETA).
maria (AE): Acme wants highs remediated or mitigated within 5 business days and a retest plan. Can we commit?
devon (Infra): S3/IAM mitigations: within 48 hours and I'll attach terraform diffs.
eli (Security Eng): Auth elevation needs a code owner. If platform team prioritizes, patch in ~5 business days; otherwise we'll apply mitigations (WAF rule, reduced session TTL) as interim.
sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare PoC scripts and schedule a 30-min validation session with Acme next week (Mon/Tue preferred).
allan (Legal): We can issue a remediation attestation after retest. If they require vendor-led third-party retest, that will need an SOW.
maria (AE): Noted. Also asked for checksums for delivered artifacts; attaching SHA256s in secure channel.
eli (Security Eng): Proposed internal timeline to share with customer:
- Day 0: owners assigned, triage sheet updated.
- Day 1-2: Infra mitigations (S3/IAM).
- Day 1-5: Platform/code fix or interim mitigations for auth elevation.
- Day 3-7: Medium findings addressed or mitigations applied.
- Day 7-14: Retest window and attestation delivery.
If any HIGH remains after Day 5 we escalate.
devon (Infra): I'll produce remediation bundle: terraform diffs, ACL snapshots, PR links, and proof-of-change screenshots.
sarah (Solutions Eng): PoC snippet for auth check:

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" https://api.redwood.internal/acme/v1/items | jq .status

eli (Security Eng): Security will run automated + manual retest. If Acme wants an external retest, we'll quote it.
allan (Legal): Also flagging risk acceptance docs if remediation affects product behavior. Need customer sign-off before breaking changes.
maria (AE): Acme has a procurement deadline 2026-04-05 and wants confirmation before then. I'll confirm if they accept internal retest or want a third-party.
security-bot: Audit log: access to s3://redwood-sec/acme/1951234999_bundle.zip recorded.
maria (AE): I'll update Acme and post their reply here. EOD update expected. :thumbsup:
